HAWE Hydraulik SE Headquarters, Munich (2009). **HAWE Hydraulik SE** is a German worldwide manufacturer and supplier company of hydraulic components and systems. ## History. The company was founded as "Heilmeier & Weinlein" in Munich in 1949. The company was renamed as "Heilmeier & Weinlein Fabrik für Oelhydraulik" in 1960 and as "HAWE Hydraulik SE" in 2008. ## Media gallery. ## References. ## External links.

title: Brand Spotlight: HAWE Industrial Hydraulics
content: # Brand Spotlight: HAWE Industrial Hydraulics. hydraulics1.jpgSince 1949, HAWE Hydraulik (then known as Heilmeier und Weinlein, Fabrik for Oelhydraulik GmbH & Co. KG.) has been a leader in quality hydraulic solutions based in Munich, Germany. Founded with a spirit of ingenuity and strength, the now-international HAWE Hydraulik SE has over 2,000 employees around the world. HAWE now works with a carefully-curated list of around 30 brand partners, one of which is Protech International. Protech is proud to offer Hawe’s state-of-the-art hydraulic solutions for commercial applications in the Charlotte area and beyond. The ‘calling card’ of HAWE’s hydraulic products is, in a word, steel. Protech International works in tandem with the highly-trained hydraulics specialists at HAWE Hydraulik to continually provide our customers with the best in modular concept hydraulics and more. From valves to lifts to full-scale cylinders, Protech is proud to supply the Carolinas with a wide array of products bearing the Hawe name, which stands for an unwavering commitment to quality.
